title: The ZIA Terraform provider: where its behavior is described

prose.text: This walks the subjects that describe what the ZIA Terraform provider sends, reads and reports. Which API paths and SDK packages each resource uses, and its arguments (type, required or optional, computed, ForceNew, defaults, enum values and validators, nested blocks), are generated from the provider code: run `node scripts/kb.mjs surface <resource name>`; `provider:zia` gives the provider's own settings.

prose.label: Connecting and activating.
prose.text: Authentication, client modes and rate limiting are in [[zia.terraform.provider-modes]]. When changes become live is in [[zia.terraform.activation]], [[zia.terraform.activation-methods]] and [[zia.terraform.activation-resource]].

prose.label: Rule order.
prose.text: How the provider applies `order` is in [[zia.terraform.rule-order]], its shared reorder registry in [[zia.terraform.rule-order.registry]], and the constraints common to rule resources in [[zia.terraform.rule-resources]].

prose.label: What reaches the API.
prose.text: Fields not sent, not read back or sent wrongly are in [[zia.terraform.field-fidelity]]. Operations that take several writes with no rollback are in [[zia.terraform.multi-step-writes]], detach-before-delete in [[zia.terraform.delete-detach]], and success reported after an error in [[zia.terraform.error-handling]]. Data sources are in [[zia.terraform.data-source-fidelity]] and [[zia.terraform.data-source-lookups]].

prose.label: Resource families.
prose.text: Policy resources: [[zia.terraform.url-filtering-rules]], [[zia.terraform.url-filtering-settings]], [[zia.terraform.url-categories]], [[zia.terraform.cloud-app-control-rule]], [[zia.terraform.firewall-resources]], [[zia.terraform.dlp-resources]] and [[zia.terraform.sandbox-resources]]. Forwarding: [[zia.terraform.traffic-forwarding-resources]] and [[zia.terraform.pac-files]]. Administration and settings: [[zia.terraform.admin-identity]], [[zia.terraform.settings]], [[zia.terraform.ueba-alerts]] and [[zia.terraform.early-access]].
